title: tests/userspace/test_ipsec.sh: IPsec xfrm tunnel with AES-GCM
description: Shell script that creates two network namespaces connected by a veth pair, establishes an IPsec/xfrm tunnel using AES-GCM-128 (the FIPS-approved AEAD for IPsec), sends traffic through the tunnel, and verifies it arrives intact. Confirms wolfkm's gcm(aes) is used for tunnel encryption. Requires root and ip/iproute2.
design: Two netns: ns_left and ns_right. veth pair: veth0/veth1. xfrm state: ip xfrm state add with proto esp, enc aes-gcm-128, reqid 1. xfrm policy: ip xfrm policy add. Ping and netcat transfer. Check /proc/crypto for wolfkm-gcm-aes during tunnel operation. See DESIGN.md §test_ipsec. Clean up with ip netns del.
acceptance_criteria: Ping across IPsec tunnel succeeds. 1MB netcat transfer across tunnel succeeds. /proc/crypto confirms wolfkm-gcm-aes. Both netns cleaned up on exit.
